The Things Stack is an open-source LoRaWAN Network Server implementation. This OpenAPI was derived from the upstream gRPC-Gateway generated api.swagger.json published by TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-stack v3.36.

Contact Support:

item.name:
Delete a list of devices within the same application.
This operation is atomic; either all devices are deleted or none.
Devices not found are skipped and no error is returned.
